answer_sql:
SELECT
  store_name,
  sales
FROM (
  SELECT
    s.store_key,
    s.store_name,
    SUM(sl.net_amount) AS sales
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS sl
  JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS s
    ON sl.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE
    s.is_online = FALSE AND s.close_date IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    s.store_key,
    s.store_name
  HAVING
    SUM(sl.net_amount) > (
      SELECT
        AVG(store_total)
      FROM (
        SELECT
          SUM(sl2.net_amount) AS store_total
        FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS sl2
        JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS s2
          ON sl2.store_key = s2.store_key
        WHERE
          s2.is_online = FALSE AND s2.close_date IS NULL
        GROUP BY
          s2.store_key
      ) AS t
    )
) AS filtered
ORDER BY
  sales DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH store_sales AS (
  SELECT
    s.store_key,
    s.store_name,
    SUM(sl.net_amount) AS sales
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS sl
  JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS s
    ON sl.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE
    s.is_online = FALSE AND s.close_date IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    s.store_key,
    s.store_name
)
SELECT
  store_name,
  sales
FROM store_sales
WHERE
  sales > (
    SELECT
      AVG(sales)
    FROM store_sales
  )
ORDER BY
  sales DESC
LIMIT 5
